ratified_decisions_bound: bos candle-close = +confidence feature (bos_candle_close_confirmed, LOW), never a gate
graded confluence stack; no all-boxes veto; labels capped at SHADOW_CANDIDATE_MEDIUM
no 2R assumption; R6 from actual tranches / posted TP1-BE behaviour / follower-capturable pips

features.name: contingency_pre_declared
features.purpose: distinguish pre-declared conditional re-entry from impulsive chains
features.needs_human_review: for weight upgrade 0->+1 after >=5 forward cases
features.failure_mode: post-hoc rationalisation; guard = declaration ts MUST precede the stop event (deterministic)

features.name: zone_touch_count
features.purpose: first mitigation potentially tradable; repeated touches = spent level, reduce confidence
features.failure_mode: zone-boundary ambiguity inflates counts; guard = only posted/pre-marked numeric zones, formation time from evidence

features.name: level_type_tag_STRONG_WEAK
features.purpose: level quality: strong = manipulated+BOS+RTO (entry-grade, wider stop); weak = liquidity target (not an entry)
features.failure_mode: subjective tagging drift; guard = tag requires citable structural evidence else UNTAGGED

features.name: confluence_order_ranking
features.purpose: confidence ordering BOS > FVG-inversion > Level-reclaim > SFP (graded stack per ratification #2); NOT a minimum count
features.failure_mode: treating ordering as additive scoring -> overfit; guard = ordering breaks ties, never sums

features.name: lane6_repaint_guard
features.purpose: indicator-sourced pre-marks must cite bar-close-confirmed values only; intra-bar/repaintable values invalid

features.name: stop_outside_zone
features.purpose: structure-relative invalidation ('just outside the zone / beyond the swept extreme') parameterised by level type; never fixed dollar constants
features.weight: MEDIUM (within invalidation-track research; not a detector score)
features.failure_mode: post-hoc stop-widening to make pre-marks survive; guard = width formula frozen per level type BEFORE each forward window

effects_on_existing.R6: ratification #3 binding; stop_outside_zone improves scratch realism; no 2R assumptions
effects_on_existing.lane6: zone_touch_count + STRONG/WEAK + confluence ordering (confidence); repaint guard (validity); stop_outside_zone (invalidation)
effects_on_existing.detector_v0_3: adds bos_candle_close_confirmed (+confidence LOW); F1 flag; F2 LOW; F3/F4 flags/tiebreakers; graded posture explicit
effects_on_existing.cycle_002_schema: capture: contingency declaration ids/ts, zone formation time, STRONG/WEAK tags, ordered confluence list, bar-close confirmation source

forbidden_uses: no automatic promotion — weight upgrades require a new human ratification record
enforcement: ai_review fail-closed validator + extended guard on every record; stamp from validator only
